# Anisotropic_Correlation_Length

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A measure of spatial correlation that differs along different axes or directions in a network, indicating directionally dependent information propagation. Guides the design of topology-aware routing and synaptic connectivity in TCC/iNEST systems to optimize directional signal flow and processing.
